How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICGEB Research Associate (Fungal Genome Engineering) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 25-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICGEB Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 25th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the essential qualifications for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Molecular Biology, or a related field, along with practical experience in enzymology and molecular biology techniques.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be selected for this position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial email application, followed by shortlisting of eligible candidates, and finally, an interview to assess their suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the nature of the employment for this Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The position of Research Associate is offered on a contractual basis, providing a fixed-term engagement for the duration of the project or as specified in the offer letter.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology located?
faq.answer: The International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB) is located in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Associate position will be determined as per the norms set by the Department of Science and Technology (DST).

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from any background apply for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates with a Ph.D. in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Molecular Biology, or related fields with specific technical experience are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q9. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email, including a complete bio-data and all necessary self-attested documents, to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: The ICGEB has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Research Associate (Fungal Genome Engineering).
